title: Remove deprecated DOMException transitive dependency
description: Apply the upstream-aligned fetch-blob native DOMException fix for Pi's pnpm Git-extension install, verify Bun and pnpm dependency graphs plus runtime behavior, and remove the install warning without changing public APIs.

logs.msg: Replaced the deprecated node-domexception edge with the native-DOMException drop-in @profoundlogic/node-domexception@1.0.2 via package.json and pnpm-workspace.yaml overrides; also selected mature non-deprecated @aws-sdk/core 3.976.0 because clean pnpm installs exposed a separate deprecated 3.977.4. Cross-manager verification is in progress.

Verified clean installs with both Bun and pnpm: node-domexception resolves to @profoundlogic/node-domexception@1.0.2, which exports native DOMException; @aws-sdk/core resolves to mature non-deprecated 3.976.0. The pnpm install emits no deprecation warning for either (only the prior 3.977.4 AWS warning is gone); stale direct package imports and the file-backed Blob NotReadableError path pass. Bun run check passes 169 tests / 404 assertions and TypeScript; bun outdated is clean. Changes are package.json, bun.lock, and pnpm-workspace.yaml; ready to commit.
